steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with one vendor bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer visibility configuration.
Apply the required bidding-time bid rejection configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-editing configuration.
Apply the required percentage counter-offer configuration.
Open the Analytics tab from the buyer's RFQ view.
Verify that the Analytics screen opened.
Confirm that known analytics content is rendered.

args.text: Use < or > to navigate the event with your keyboard

steps.note: Confirm the analytics guidance content is visible.
Verify that the analytics screen shows no application error.
